props.placeholder: Scan a super-lot label, an LTT or a container label

config.script:
v = self.view
	t = (v.custom.scanText or "").strip()
	if not t:
		return
	hit = BlueRidge.Quality.ControlledRun.findByScan(t)
	v.custom.scanText = ""
	if hit.get("runId"):
		v.custom.filter = {"statusCode": "All", "text": ""}   # so a scanned closed super-lot is in the list it is selected in
		system.perspective.sendMessage("controlledRunSelect", payload={"runId": hit.get("runId")}, scope="page")
	else:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Not found", hit.get("message") or "Scan not recognised.", "warning")

system.perspective.openPopup("mpp-controlled-run-new", "BlueRidge/Components/Popups/ControlledRunNew",
		params={"popupId": "mpp-controlled-run-new",
			"terminalLocationId": self.session.custom.terminal.terminalLocationId},
		position={"width": "92%", "height": "92%"},
		modal=True, showCloseIcon=True, overlayDismiss=False, viewportBound=True)

config.script:
uid = BlueRidge.Common.Session.currentAppUserId(self.session)
	tid = self.session.custom.terminal.terminalLocationId
	res = BlueRidge.Quality.ControlledRun.printLabels(self.view.custom.selectedRunId, uid, tid)

		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Not printed", res.get("Message") or "", "warning")   # refused before anything was sent
	else:
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyPrintResult(res, "Super-lot labels")

props.text: Tap a row to select it. The arrow opens LOT Detail. Members are released with a signature on the Sign-off tab.
Select a super-lot on the left, scan a label, or start a new one.

messageHandlers.script:
p = payload or {}
	rid = p.get("runId")
	v = self.view
	v.custom.selectedRunId = rid
	v.custom.selectedMemberId = None
	v.custom.selectedMemberName = ""
	# Bring the member list up to date for the super-lot being opened. Never let it block selection.
	from java.lang import Throwable
	try:
		if rid:
			BlueRidge.Quality.ControlledRun.sync(rid, BlueRidge.Common.Util.systemAppUserId())
	except (Exception, Throwable) as e:
		BlueRidge.Common.Util.log("super-lot sync on select failed: %s" % e, level="warn")
	v.custom.refreshToken = (v.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1

v = self.view
	v.custom.selectedMemberId = None
	v.custom.selectedMemberName = ""
	v.custom.refreshToken = (v.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1

# Replayed by Common.Session.dispatchElevatedAction once a Quality sign-in window is
	# open (straight away when one already is). "signin" is a sign-in with nothing to
	# replay: the person repeats what they were doing.
	p = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(payload) or {}
	a = p.get("action")
	if a in ("add", "remove", "endWindow", "resumeWindow", "close", "cancel", "voidResult"):
		system.perspective.openPopup("mpp-controlled-run-confirm", "BlueRidge/Components/Popups/ControlledRunConfirm",
			params={"popupId": "mpp-controlled-run-confirm", "action": a,
				"runId": p.get("runId") or self.view.custom.selectedRunId,
				"runNumber": p.get("runNumber") or self.view.custom.run.RunNumber,
				"memberId": p.get("memberId"), "memberName": p.get("memberName") or "",
				"resultId": p.get("resultId"),
				"terminalLocationId": self.session.custom.terminal.terminalLocationId},
			position={"width": "640px", "height": "62%"},
			modal=True, showCloseIcon=True, overlayDismiss=False, viewportBound=True)
	elif a == "repack":
		system.perspective.openPopup("mpp-controlled-run-repack", "BlueRidge/Components/Popups/ControlledRunRepack",
			params={"popupId": "mpp-controlled-run-repack", "containerId": p.get("containerId"),
				"terminalLocationId": self.session.custom.terminal.terminalLocationId},
			position={"width": "1180px", "height": "88%"},
			modal=True, showCloseIcon=True, overlayDismiss=False, viewportBound=True)
	elif a == "signin":
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Signed in", "Quality sign-in is open. Carry on.", "success")
